verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agents can produce code as git branches/PRs and logs/traces can be retrieved via API (docs-13, docs-17, docs-27), but there is no documented feature for exporting all account data (agent history, integration configs, org settings) in open/portable formats, nor any data-portability or account-deletion/export tooling mentioned. Missing for 10: a full account/data export mechanism, documented open-format export (e.g., JSON/CSV bulk export), and any statement about data portability or user ability to leave with all data.
